slug: 2026-05-07 What will determine the success of Rwanda’s data governance push

facts.fact: Cenfri's interview with NISR's Data Governance Project Lead says the policy is in place (the public sector data sharing policy), with implementation now the question; the document gives no approval date, so the date used is the document's published date.

The document says the Data Governance Unit at the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda has been established and serves as the operational arm of the public sector data sharing policy, with staff in place and projects started; it gives no establishment date, so the date used is the document's published date.
